dash.framing: Hands-on exercises, run by AI. Pick a goal, then start one — each ends in something you keep.
dash.framingCurated: Hands-on exercises, run by AI. These are the ones picked for you — start any one. Each ends in something you keep.

catalog.cohortOnly: يعمل مباشرة مع مجموعة. افتح رابط مجموعة الميسّر للمشاركة.

reimagine-job.name: Redesign Your Job with a Partner
reimagine-job.tagline: Interview a partner and redesign each other's jobs with the 2×4 model: the human work, and what AI can take.

reimagine-workflow.name: Redesign a Workflow with a Partner
reimagine-workflow.tagline: Pick a real workflow and redraw it with a partner. Learn to weigh AI's tradeoffs and put people and AI in the right seats, instead of just patching what you have.

benchmark.name: You vs. AI: A Reasoning Test
benchmark.tagline: Take a timed reasoning test, then see your score against the whole room, and against AI on the same questions. An honest read on where humans still have the edge.

workflow-solo.name: Redesign a Workflow with AI
workflow-solo.tagline: Describe a workflow and let AI interview you, then watch it redraw the flow. Learn who should do what once AI and humans share the work, and leave with a redesign.

network.name: Map the Room's Network (Live)
network.tagline: Map the room's real advice and friendship networks, live and anonymous, then see who's actually most central. A vivid lesson in how influence really flows.

jd-x-ray.name: Analyze a Role's AI Exposure
jd-x-ray.tagline: Paste a job description and see which tasks AI can do. Then learn to rewrite the role as a human+AI job, and exactly who to hire for it.

career-x-ray.name: Analyze Your Career's AI Exposure
career-x-ray.tagline: Paste your résumé and see which parts of your work AI can do. Then learn the higher-value work to lean into, and where your career can go next.

vendor-disclosure.name: Vet a Vendor's Disclosure
vendor-disclosure.tagline: Send a vendor one open link and get a structured disclosure back. AI then scores it against a proven framework and flags the gaps and red flags before you buy.

haip-disclosure.name: Vet a Healthcare AI Vendor
haip-disclosure.tagline: Send a healthcare AI vendor one open link and get a full Health AI Partnership disclosure back, covering model performance, bias, and HIPAA, with AI flagging what needs local validation.

career-roadmap.name: Map Your Next Career Moves
career-roadmap.tagline: See your skill-adjacent next career moves (lateral, step-up, and stretch), and learn exactly which skills to build to get there, sequenced into a roadmap for the next 24 months.

solo-ai.name: Redesign Your Job with AI
solo-ai.tagline: Find your real job, hand AI the busywork, keep the judgment with you. No partner needed.

execution-4a.name: Score Your Execution Plan
execution-4a.tagline: Pressure-test an initiative against the 4 A's and find the one fix most likely to get it executing.

close-the-offer.name: Negotiate a Job Offer
close-the-offer.tagline: Negotiate a multi-issue job offer live against an AI hiring manager, then get scored on the value you claimed and created. Learn where you left money on the table.

name-your-price.name: Practice a Price Negotiation
name-your-price.tagline: Haggle over a single price against an AI seller with a hidden floor. Learn to anchor, hold your walk-away, and claim your share of the bargaining zone.

ask-for-a-raise.name: Ask for a Raise
ask-for-a-raise.tagline: Negotiate your own pay and package with an AI manager, across raise, title, remote, and more. Learn to trade for what you value instead of just pushing on the number.

close-the-vendor-deal.name: Close a Vendor Deal
close-the-vendor-deal.tagline: Negotiate a software contract with an AI account exec: price, term, payment, support, and more. Learn to trade the terms they value for the ones you do.

lease-the-space.name: Negotiate the Rent
lease-the-space.tagline: Haggle over a monthly office rent against an AI landlord with a hidden floor. Practice anchoring, holding your walk-away, and claiming the bargaining zone.

rehearse-hard-conversation.name: Rehearse a Hard Conversation
rehearse-hard-conversation.tagline: Practice a hard conversation (letting someone go, tough feedback, denying a promotion, a PIP, or pushing back on your boss) with an AI who reacts like a real person. Then get coached on the tape.

define-vision.name: Shape Your Company Vision
define-vision.tagline: Think through a lasting vision for your organization with an AI facilitator: what it stands for, why it exists, and the bold future it's working toward. Leave with your vision written back to you.

define-vision-voice.name: Talk Through Your Vision
define-vision-voice.tagline: The vision conversation as a hands-free voice session. Just talk while an AI facilitator draws out what your organization stands for and where it's headed, then get your vision written up.

find-problem.name: Find a Problem Worth Solving
find-problem.tagline: For a founder, consultant, or researcher commercializing: with an AI coach, hunt the one recurring, expensive, newly-solvable problem (close to your edge) that many buyers will pay to fix. It then checks the problem against the real world and grades it.

find-org-problems.name: Find Your Organization's Highest-Value Problems
find-org-problems.tagline: For a leader with resources to allocate: an AI coach surfaces where your next hour, dollar, or hire creates the most value. You get a ranked map of internal opportunities, corroborated against real evidence, with what to stop to fund the winner.

find-problem-voice.name: Talk Through a Problem Worth Solving
find-problem-voice.tagline: The problem hunt as a hands-free voice conversation. Just talk while an AI strategist draws out the recurring, expensive, newly-solvable problem closest to your edge, checks it against the real world, and grades it.

find-org-problems-voice.name: Talk Through Your Organization's Highest-Value Problems
find-org-problems-voice.tagline: The leader's opportunity audit as a hands-free voice conversation. Just talk while an AI strategist surfaces where value is leaking, corroborates it against real evidence, and returns a ranked map with what to stop to fund the winner.

good-business.name: Pressure-Test a Business Idea
good-business.tagline: Pressure-test a business idea against real frameworks and real unit economics. Learn whether the market is attractive, where your edge is durable, and what would have to be true to win.

balanced-scorecard.name: Build a Balanced Scorecard
balanced-scorecard.tagline: Turn a strategy into objectives, measurable results, and initiatives across the four Balanced Scorecard perspectives, and learn how they link as one cause-and-effect chain.

deeptech-canvas.name: Plan a Deep-Tech Venture
deeptech-canvas.tagline: Separate a deep-tech venture's technical and market uncertainty, then design the one experiment that resolves the biggest. Learn the path from lab capability to real strategy.

ai-canvas.name: Find Where AI Fits a Workflow
ai-canvas.tagline: Map one workflow to find where AI actually belongs, and leave with an implementation-grade plan.

opportunity-capability.name: Should You Make This Bet?
opportunity-capability.tagline: Test an opportunity against what you can actually do, and find the gap most likely to break the bet.

test-the-bet.name: Design a Test for Your Strategy
test-the-bet.tagline: Turn a strategic belief into a runnable experiment you could start this week, before you commit.

business-consult.name: Diagnose Your Business in 30 Minutes
business-consult.tagline: Free AI consulting for your business. A guided interview, a management-practices check, a photo read of the operation, and an 80/20 look add up to one clear picture: what kind of business you are, where your margin really lives, and what to fix first.

find-superpower.name: Find Your Superpower
find-superpower.tagline: Your rarest strength is usually invisible to you, because it feels effortless. An AI interview pulls the stories, finds the thread across them, and names the 2 to 3 abilities that make you hard to replace, with the VRIN-O moat and how to build a career around it.

ai-board.name: Convene Your AI Board
ai-board.tagline: Bring a decision. Four AI advisors debate it live, a growth optimist, a skeptic, your customer, and your operator, reacting to each other and to you. You moderate, then call the vote for a verdict.

voice-consult.name: Talk Through Your Business
voice-consult.tagline: A spoken interview about your business. An AI advisor asks you questions out loud, you just talk back, and it turns the conversation into a real consult: what kind of business you are, where your margin lives, and what to fix first.

customer-empathy.name: Understand Your Customer
customer-empathy.tagline: Send a potential customer one link. An AI runs a warm, design-thinking empathy interview for you, then hands back who they are, the job they're hiring you to do, their real pains and gains, and an empathy map you can act on. Do it with many customers and it finds the pattern.

refresh-resume.name: Refresh Your Résumé
refresh-resume.tagline: An AI coach interviews you about this year's real wins, then hands back the exact résumé changes to make.

refresh-resume-voice.name: Talk Through Your Résumé
refresh-resume-voice.tagline: The résumé refresh, hands-free: talk through your year while an AI coach draws out the wins.

business-myopia.name: Find Your Business's Blind Spots
business-myopia.tagline: The success that got you here quietly narrows what you notice. An AI advisor maps your business as a bundle of choices, then names the blind spots you can't see, distant markets, coming shifts, and the bets you're not taking, and hands you a plan to explore before you're forced to.

personal-network.name: Map Your Personal Network
personal-network.tagline: Map the people around you, across your org, your industry, and your personal life, and see the real shape of your network: where you broker between separate worlds, where you're boxed in, and the specific moves that would open it up.

domain-brief.name: Domain Expertise Brief
domain-brief.tagline: Name a technology domain and a scope (a university, a region, or the world), and get a decision-ready brief: the real experts, the standout work, and where the strength is, scored for commercial and scientific potential by Scientifiq.

find-collaborators.name: Find Collaborators
find-collaborators.tagline: Describe your research and find the people at your university who complement it, the ones who add a method, a domain, a clinical partner, or a co-PI you don't already have, each with a draft intro to send.

licensing-brief.name: Licensing Brief
licensing-brief.tagline: Paste a disclosure or abstract and get a decision-ready licensing brief: its predicted commercial potential, the nearby patent landscape, who to approach, the risks, and an outreach plan.

score-my-invention.name: Score My Invention
score-my-invention.tagline: Paste an invention, disclosure, or research idea and get its full impact fingerprint (commercial, scientific, social, and deeper potential) scored against the field, plus concrete ways to raise it.

defense-impact.name: Defense Impact
defense-impact.tagline: Paste a paper or research idea and estimate its defense and national-security relevance, the domains it touches, and, from the patents that cite it, whether it is already feeding defense technology.

impact-optimizer.name: Impact Optimizer
impact-optimizer.tagline: Paste an abstract and pick a target (commercial, scientific, defense, and more) and find the missing science: the concrete experiments and extensions that would raise that potential most, each scored by the models.

explain-ai.name: ExplainAI
explain-ai.tagline: Paste a paper's abstract and get it translated into plain language, framed for a policymaker, an investor, a researcher in another field, and the public, with the jargon translated too.

position-my-research.name: Position My Research
position-my-research.tagline: Paste a paper or research idea and see its scientific, social, and commercial potential against the field, plus concrete ways to reframe it for more impact, citations, and funding.

rank-disclosures.name: Rank Our Disclosures
rank-disclosures.tagline: Paste a batch of disclosures and get them scored and ranked by commercial potential, with an AI read on which few to prioritize for patenting and licensing.

find-a-cofounder.name: Find a Technical Co-Founder
find-a-cofounder.tagline: Describe your venture's technology and find researchers who can actually build it, ranked for commercial orientation and depth, each with a draft outreach message.

diligence-the-science.name: Diligence the Science
diligence-the-science.tagline: Paste a startup's claimed technology and get an investor-grade read on whether the underlying science is real, strong, and close to commercialization.

nearest-expert.name: Nearest Expert
nearest-expert.tagline: Describe your technical problem and where you are, and get the researchers who can help, nearest first: someone you could visit, then the best in your country, then the world leaders.

science-radar.name: Science Radar
science-radar.tagline: Name a company and see the science its patents build on, the highest-potential researchers at the frontier of its fields, who else is building on the same science, and the work it isn't using yet.

science-intel.name: Science Intelligence
science-intel.tagline: Three warehouse-powered reads on the science frontier: a talent map of a field (who's the best, and who they patent for), a country's research strengths, and the firms quietly building on your company's science.

earnings-call.name: The Earnings Call
earnings-call.tagline: You're the analyst on a live earnings call. A short-seller says the CEO faked the quarter with channel stuffing. Interrogate the AI CEO, and get scored on how much your questions reveal.

star-hire.name: Star Hire
star-hire.tagline: Four candidates, all impressive on paper. Interview them, hire one, and find out how much of each one's success was really theirs, not their old firm's platform.

incentive-lab.name: The Incentive Lab
incentive-lab.tagline: Design a reward system, then watch AI workers red-team it by self-play, discovering every way to hit your numbers while the real goal quietly rots. Redesign until they can't.

regression-detective.name: Regression Detective
regression-detective.tagline: A dataset with a hidden truth. Explore it in a bare-bones stats console, then submit the model you think generated the data. You're graded against the real data-generating process.

hot-seat.name: The Hot Seat
hot-seat.tagline: The roles flip: now you're the CEO on a live earnings call, and a relentless AI analyst thinks you cooked the books. Answer truthfully, never say anything false, and hedge where you should.

the-number.name: The Number
the-number.tagline: A four-person team capstone. One of you starts a team and shares the code; the other three join. You run a CFO's office and must hit analyst consensus using legal earnings management, survive an analyst call, and face the cost.

technology-landscape.name: Technology Landscape Scan
technology-landscape.tagline: Name a technology or field and get a landscape: who leads it, which companies are commercializing it, the strongest work, and where the white space is.

deep-tech-deal-sourcing.name: Deep-Tech Deal Sourcing
deep-tech-deal-sourcing.tagline: Name your investment thesis and surface labs whose science is both high-quality and commercializing, spin-out candidates to reach before they raise.

commercialization-scorecard.name: University Commercialization Scorecard
commercialization-scorecard.tagline: Pick an institution and a field to score how commercially oriented its research is, its real strengths, and where it lags a leading program.

field-trajectory.name: Where Is My Field Going?
field-trajectory.tagline: Name a field and see which subfields are rising, where scientific and commercial value is concentrating, and what to bet on next.

career-myopia.name: Find Your Career's Blind Spots
career-myopia.tagline: The skills that made you successful can quietly trap you. An AI advisor maps your career as a bundle of choices, then names what you're not seeing, adjacent moves, coming shifts in your field, and the experiments you're avoiding, and a plan to explore before your peak erodes.

research-good.name: 1 · What Makes Research Good
research-good.tagline: Research as a craft: the null model, making the invisible visible, GAS, and the four tests.

research-idea.name: 2 · Every Idea Is an Interaction
research-idea.tagline: IF X → Y, ESPECIALLY/EXCEPT WHEN Z, BECAUSE a mechanism, and why β₃ is the idea.

research-paper.name: 3 · The Anatomy of a Paper
research-paper.tagline: The hourglass, nested parallelism, the six-sentence abstract, and a title people can find.

research-argument.name: 4 · Building the Argument
research-argument.tagline: Theory, counter-arguments, the three tables, and one clear point per paragraph.

research-data.name: 5 · Reading the Data
research-data.tagline: Correlation vs causation, the gradient of control, and why randomization works.

research-publish.name: 6 · Getting Published & Heard
research-publish.tagline: The lit review's two jobs, the R&R as an exam, presenting in five parts, and the weakest link.

what-is-a-paper.name: Make the Invisible Visible
what-is-a-paper.tagline: Turn your study into one sharp insight: the invisible force it makes visible, and why the facts are what they are.

paper-structure.name: Structure Your Paper
paper-structure.tagline: Lay your paper out as an hourglass, from motivation to contribution, with a clear job for every section.

making-points.name: Make Your Points
making-points.tagline: Reduce your paper to a sequence of points, one per paragraph, that lead to a single conclusion.

read-the-interaction.name: The Anatomy of an Idea
read-the-interaction.tagline: Build a research idea and see its shape: IF X then Y, especially or except when Z, because a mechanism, drawn as a graph and a regression.

strategy-experiment.name: The Strategy Experiment
strategy-experiment.tagline: Design a strategy field experiment on the eight-part canvas, then run it in silico: AI proposes the data-generating process and the app actually simulates the trial.

publication-pipeline.name: Publication Pipeline
publication-pipeline.tagline: See how publishing actually works, why you can't out-write a 3 to 5 percent acceptance rate, and the one lever that moves it.

understand-a-paper.name: Understand a Paper
understand-a-paper.tagline: Take any paper apart through four lenses: its idea, its structure, its points, and its key interaction.

good-research.name: What Makes a Paper Good
good-research.tagline: Judge an idea honestly: a clear null, a hidden factor others miss, and four tests, important, interesting, ambitious, and craft.

regression-tables.name: Clear Regression Tables
regression-tables.tagline: Make your main table readable at a glance: one idea, the key coefficient spotlighted, columns that build a narrative.

research-graphs.name: Elegant Research Graphs
research-graphs.tagline: Design a graph that is the argument: it shows the finding directly and elegantly, with nothing wasted.

literature-reviews.name: Position Your Literature Review
literature-reviews.tagline: Turn the review from a summary dump into a setup for your contribution: the support, the gap, organized by ideas.

data-moat.name: Is Your Data a Moat?
data-moat.tagline: Judge your dataset as a research advantage with VRIN+O: valuable, rare, inimitable, non-substitutable, and organized to publish from.

data-strategy.name: Choose Your Data Strategy
data-strategy.tagline: Pick the data that can actually answer your question: public, trace, survey, experiment, qualitative, or simulation, and what each buys.

identification.name: Is Your Identification Credible?
identification.tagline: Stress-test a causal claim: the biggest threat, the design that answers it, the identifying assumption, and a test that could falsify it.

the-referee.name: Meet Your Reviewers
the-referee.tagline: See the referee report you're likely to get: what a reviewer likes, the objections ranked, the fixes, and the likely decision.

revise-resubmit.name: The R&R War Room
revise-resubmit.tagline: Turn reviewer comments into a systematic response: every comment answered as a dialogue, with the respectful pushback and the letter.

journal-fit.name: Journal Fit & Cover Letter
journal-fit.tagline: Pick the right venue and pitch it: fit is half the battle, and the wrong journal is a fast rejection.

theory-section.name: Build Your Theory Section
theory-section.tagline: Set up a null model, advance a non-obvious claim, and give the reasons to believe it that lead to your hypotheses.

abstract-title.name: The Abstract & Title
abstract-title.tagline: Write the abstract as a microcosm of the paper, motivation to contribution, then test titles that communicate and can be found.

research-system.name: Design Your Research System
research-system.tagline: Redesign how you actually work: automate the drudgery, delegate the rest, and standardize your stack, so you reach the creative work faster.

research-team.name: Build Your Research Team
research-team.tagline: Find the complementary coauthors a strong paper needs: the architect, the builder, and the electrician.

what-is-a-phd.name: Is a Business PhD for You?
what-is-a-phd.tagline: An honest read on what a business PhD actually is, research training to become a professor, and whether it fits what you want.

choose-phd-program.name: Choose a PhD Program
choose-phd-program.tagline: Judge programs on what actually matters: placement above all, then faculty fit in your area, funding, and culture.

phd-application.name: Get Into a PhD Program
phd-application.tagline: Build your application by seeing it from the committee's side: they're betting ~$300k that you'll become a researcher who publishes.

phd-structure.name: How a PhD Works
phd-structure.tagline: Map the phases, coursework, comps, qualifying paper, research, job-market paper, job market, and nail the one you're in.

phd-succeed.name: Succeed in Your PhD
phd-succeed.tagline: The habits that separate thriving students: papers and presentations, visibility, taking advice, and modeling the best above you.

phd-placement.name: Land an Academic Job
phd-placement.tagline: Judge your job-market paper the way a hiring department will: Important, Interesting, Ambitious, backed by a pipeline.

ai-rules.name: 1 · When Humans Wrote the Logic
ai-rules.tagline: The first era of AI: expert systems and hand-written rules, and the wall that stopped them.

ai-learning.name: 2 · Letting the Data Learn
ai-learning.tagline: Statistical learning and neural networks: stop writing rules, learn the function from examples.

ai-language.name: 3 · Predicting the Next Word
ai-language.tagline: From Markov chains to Transformers: how predicting the next word became large language models.

ai-scale.name: 4 · Scale, Self-Play & the Limits
ai-scale.tagline: The bitter lesson, scaling laws, self-play, and an honest account of what AI can and can't do.

lab-prompting.name: Prompting Lab
lab-prompting.tagline: Turn a vague ask into a prompt that gets the output you meant.

lab-agents.name: Agent Simulator
lab-agents.tagline: Design an agent's tools and guardrails, then watch the loop run and see where it breaks.

lab-vibe-coding.name: Vibe Coding Studio
lab-vibe-coding.tagline: Build with AI the way the good builders do: spec first, small deltas, data-aware.

sessions.empty: Nothing yet. Start an exercise above to begin.
